LESSON: COMPASS DIRECTION

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Natural and Historic Built Environments Compass Direction (6 lessons) Location a
Topic 1.1: Compass Direction

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Compass Direction
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can we show direction of places?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify the four cardinal points of a compass
2. use the four cardinal points to give directions on a map
3. appreciate the use of four cardinal points in everyday life

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify the four cardinal points of a compass

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify the four cardinal points of a compass
2. Practise: use the four cardinal points to give directions on a map
